headline.purpose: Section titles in the margin column; current job title.

lead.purpose: Role phrase and project short description.

data.purpose: Geist Mono for dates, skill levels, stacks.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: durations collapse to 0.01ms; smooth scroll off

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single solid action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border-radius: 3px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--rule); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--accent); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink); } .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 12px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 3px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Header anchor; active state is a teal underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-muted); text-underline-offset: 8px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-active { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--accent); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; }

components.name: Ruled Definition List
components.description: Signature pattern: muted label, ink value, hairline rows.
components.css: .ds-dl { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); font-size: 14px; margin: 0; } .ds-dl > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7rem 1fr; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-dl dt { color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-dl dd { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Skill Row
components.description: Level as typography; mono level word at right.
components.css: .ds-skill { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); font-size: 14px; } .ds-skill-name { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); } .ds-skill-level { font-family: var(--font-mono), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-muted); }

narrative.overview:
The site is set like an engineering record: facts, architecture and repo links are the visual content, and the interface recedes. Structure comes from hairline rules and a two-column margin layout, never from cards, glow, or ornament. It reads in daylight on a phone first; a dark theme is a deep blue-black, not a navy gradient.

One accent, signal teal, appears only where something is actionable or focused. Everything else is ink on paper, with weight and tone (not chips or badges) carrying hierarchy. Geist does all the talking; Geist Mono appears only for data.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline rules are the only container; no cards, no shadows, no gradients.
Section title sits in a left margin column (13rem), content in the right.
One radius (3px), one accent, two themes switched by `data-theme` on `<html>`.
Hit targets are at least 44px (`min-h-11`); focus is always visible.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal marks links-in-waiting, focus, and the single primary action per view. If it is decorative, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Hairline Container Rule
rules.body: Grouping is a 1px rule above or below, never a box, fill, or shadow.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for dates, levels, versions and stacks only, never headings or prose.

rules.name: The Level-As-Weight Rule
rules.body: Skill confidence is conveyed by weight and tone (semibold, medium, regular muted, italic muted) with the level word always printed.

rules.name: The Flat-Always Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no blur, no glow on page surfaces; state changes use underline color, opacity, or a raised-paper fill.

dos: Do put grouping in hairline rules and the left-margin title column.
Do keep teal to the primary action, focus, active nav and link-hover underline.
Do use `rounded-ui` (3px) for every control and set mono type only for data.
Do keep 44px minimum hit targets and honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do derive hero facts from `data/` so the first screen stays true.
donts: Don't use shadows, gradients, glow, glass, or colored backgrounds as containers.
Don't add pills, badges, status dots, or icon tiles.
Don't introduce a second accent or a second radius.
Don't set Geist Mono on headings or prose.
